title: The Last Alibi Again
author: Vesper Crane
blurb: Wren Reyes, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
